decisions.quote: In this Follow-up study, strong evidence for linkage was observed at 6q23-24 ( p = 0.002) and suggestive support for linkage was observed at 18q22 ( p = 0.03). No evidence for linkage was observed in the Follow-up Sample at 2q33 ( p = 0.2), 4p16 ( p = 0.5), 5q31-32 ( p = 0.2) and 6p22.3 ( p = 0.4). The lack of confirmation for the latter four loci may indicate that these regions do not contain genes that modify the age at neurologic onset for HD or that this relatively small Follow-up study did not adequately sample families which carry modifier genes from these regions.
decisions.reason: The study re-tested six linkage regions from the original genome scan, confirming linkage at 6q23-24 (with suggestive support at 18q22) while explicitly reporting a lack of confirmation at the other four tested loci (2q33, 4p16, 5q31-32, and 6p22.3). Confirming one specific locus is a comparison for that effect rather than an overall verdict on all six replicated loci, so the outcome is mixed.
